neighbours.label: the source-material slot of an active transformation: fires on a make-into verb (convert, transform, repurpose) or the 'from'/determiner introducing the existing thing about to be made into something new
neighbours.short: source material of a convert/make-from transformation
neighbours.notes: Context-level label. Passive 'X are converted into' and 'remixed' did not fire in probes; ambiguous 'turned' fired weakly. Near misses keep subject, object and scene and swap the transformation verb for a non-transforming one. The last two pairs were written fresh, unprobed.
fire: The engineers converted an old warehouse into a modern art studio.
She made a lamp from the empty wine bottles she had saved.
We can transform this vague idea into a working product.
The town repurposed the abandoned railway as a long cycling path.
He carved a small spoon from a branch of cherry wood.
Students build model rockets from cardboard tubes and tape.
The company converted its old factory into luxury apartments.
Artists transform scrap metal into towering sculptures.
quiet: The engineers inspected an old warehouse near the modern art studio.
She bought a lamp and the empty wine bottles she had saved.
We can discuss this vague idea about a working product.
The town photographed the abandoned railway beside a long cycling path.
He found a small spoon beside a branch of cherry wood.
Students launch model rockets near cardboard tubes and tape.
The company sold its old factory near luxury apartments.
Artists stack scrap metal beside towering sculptures.
